boundaries: These sources support terminology and anatomical relationships; they do not license copying figures, images, textures or meshes.
Reference-only targets are educational metadata, not claims of available 3D geometry.
Pupil, visual axis and other spaces/openings are not fabricated as tissue meshes.
No patient-specific geometry, diagnosis, treatment recommendation, surgical coordinate or autonomous decision is produced.
Histology, cellular anatomy, molecular pathways and physiology are deferred to later evidence-gated waves.
